title: 第17章 小有薄名第18章 可否能换条腿
content_zh:
待那火光更近些，他才看清，那竟是一头体型壮硕的犬类妖兽，其尾巴末端一团赤焰熊熊燃烧，在身后拖出一道流火残影。
巨犬背上，一名青袍修士，外袍褴褛，内露皮甲，却神色安然，悍然之气扑面而来。
周围十几条猎犬簇拥追随！
“祸斗血脉？”
“这是……觉醒了血脉神通？”
“御兽觉醒血脉，主人岂不是也觉醒了血脉神通？”
曾子昂脸上刚刚泛起的一丝优越感，陡然凝固。
那犬背之人，不是陈知白，又是谁？
去时，群犬皆凡；
归来，一头猎犬，已然跃升为妖兽，那燃烧的尾焰光芒，灼得他眼疼。
御兽如此，主人呢？
……
陈知白奔腾如风，迅速超过同门，返回师门。
不怪他如此火急火燎。
却是返程路上，愣是被一头妖化的夜枭盯上。
天知道，是不是突然觉醒血脉，狂得没边，也敢攻击他的狗群。
几番俯冲，想要抓他。
偏偏还俯冲还悄无声息，亏他回声定位犀利，几次出剑格挡，这才化险为夷。
难怪都不敢远离老律观太远。
陈知白刚刚越过道门牌楼，倏然就有人冲上来，拱手道：“恭喜道友，喜得机缘，不知可愿割爱座下御兽？”

陈知白连连摆手：“不卖不卖。”
不等对方开口，便是呼啸而去。
他没有返回私人袇房，而是往招财犬舍而去。
再见坊主舒朗清，其惊得瞪大眼睛，指着陈知白座下得福：“我的娘嘞，这、这是铁包金？”
陈知白笑道：“还要多谢坊主火眼金睛，养了一群好御兽。”
舒朗清神色复杂，半晌，开口道：“这祸斗……”
“不卖！”
“我的意思是……可否能借我配种，当然，价钱好说。”
“再说吧，不知寄养这些御兽，要多少钱？”
“哎呦，都是自家兄弟，一个月内免费。”
陈知白闻言笑了笑：“那就叨扰几日了。”
他打算重新租个房子，带院子那种，不然一群御兽，总寄养在犬坊，终究不甚方便。
说起来，要是能有空间法器就好了。
可惜，这玩意儿价格太高。
据他所知，空间法器也分好几个等级。
其中，最好法器，乃是壶天遁世道弟子炼制而出的须弥法器。
这支道脉，甚是了得，藏天下于天下，而不得所遁。最擅长操控空间，隐迹缩地，故而盛产须弥法器。
据说甚至能炼制出洞天福地。
content_en:
When the fire came closer, he could see clearly that it was actually a strong canine monster. A ball of red flame burned blazingly at the end of its tail, dragging out a trail of flowing fire shadow behind it.
On the back of the giant dog, there is a green-robed monk. His outer robe is ragged and his leather armor is exposed, but his expression is calm, and he has a fierce aura coming towards him.
There are more than a dozen hounds surrounding him!
"Haudou bloodline?"
"Is this... the awakening of bloodline magical power?"
"When the beast master awakens his bloodline, doesn't the master also awaken his bloodline magical power?"
The sense of superiority that had just appeared on Zeng Ziang's face suddenly solidified.
That person on the dog's back is not Chen Zhibai, who is it?
When he left, all the dogs were ordinary;
When he returned, a hound had transformed into a monster, and the burning tail flame made his eyes hurt.
If you control the beast like this, where is the master?
…
Chen Zhibai galloped like the wind, quickly surpassing his fellow disciples and returning to his master's gate.
No wonder he was so impatient.
But on the way back, he was stared at by a demonized night owl.
God knows if he suddenly awakened his bloodline and became so crazy that he dared to attack his dogs.
I dived several times, trying to catch him.
However, he still dived silently. Thanks to his sharp echo positioning, he used his sword to block several times and finally saved the day.
No wonder they don’t dare to stray too far away from the Old Law Temple.
As soon as Chen Zhibai crossed the Taoist archway, someone suddenly rushed up to him, cupping his hands and saying, "Congratulations to fellow Taoist, I'm so happy for this opportunity. I wonder if I'd rather give up my love to control the beast?"
Chen Zhibai waved his hands repeatedly: "No, no, no."
Without waiting for the other party to speak, he whizzed away.
He did not return to the private room, but went to the Lucky Kennel.
Seeing the shop owner Shu Langqing again, his eyes widened in shock and he pointed at Chen Zhibai's blessing: "My mother, this, is this iron-clad gold?"
Chen Zhibai smiled and said: "I would also like to thank the master for his sharp eyes and raising a group of good beast masters."
Shu Langqing had a complicated look on his face, and after a while, he said: "This disaster..."
"Not for sale!"
"What I mean is...can you lend me a breeding stock? Of course, the price is easy to negotiate."
"Besides, I wonder how much it will cost to foster these beasts?"
"Hey, we are all brothers, free for a month."
Chen Zhibai smiled when he heard this: "Then I'll bother you for a few days."
He planned to rent a new house with a yard. Otherwise, it would be inconvenient for a group of beasts to be kept in a dog house.
Speaking of which, it would be great if there were space magic weapons.
Unfortunately, the price of this thing is too high.
As far as he knew, space magic weapons were divided into several levels.
Among them, the best magical weapon is the Sumeru magical weapon refined by the disciples of Hutian Escape from the World.
This Dao lineage is so remarkable that it is hidden all over the world and cannot be escaped. It is best at controlling space and disappearing into the ground, so it is rich in Xumi magic weapons.
It is said that it can even be used to refine the Cave Heaven Blessed Land.
